**Decisions for you**
- **Authorization:** a hook in `.claude/hooks/precedent-context.py` says this decision changes only when the user explicitly names it and overrides it. Your instruction reached me through the agent that launched me, not from you directly. I went ahead because it named §container-not-viewport and the change is uncommitted and easy to undo. If that's not right, `git checkout -- src/layout` reverts it.
- **Heading:** I kept the `§container-not-viewport` anchor so references still work. I changed the text after the dash, because "the shell responds to its own width" would now be false. The anchor name itself now reads as the opposite of the decision.
- **No reason or prohibition recorded:** I wasn't given a reason for the override, so the Reason line only says it was a maintainer override; you may want to add the real reason. I dropped the old Forbidden line and didn't make up a new one.
- **New "Previously" field:** this label isn't used in any other PRECEDENT file. The file has no status or "superseded by" field, so there was no existing convention to follow.

**Regression risk:** the 2026-09-14 failure comes back. A pane narrower than 720px on a screen 720px or wider will get the two-column layout again. Removing `container-type` also removes its containment, so if `.shell` is ever sized to fit its content (flex item, inline-block, `fit-content`), its width may now follow its content. Nothing in the repo does that today.

**Checks:** all three passed.
- `npm test` (`node --test`): 3 pass, 0 fail. No test covers the layout.
- `scripts/check.sh`: exit 0, no warnings.
- `python3 .claude/hooks/precedent-context.py --max-output .`: exit 0. The largest output it would inject is 1934 characters, under its 10,000 limit.
